core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Frizzled signaling
qualifier: Frizzled/LRP5 receptor regulation and paraxial mesoderm formation
name: Wnt secretion, Frizzled receptor regulation and paraxial mesoderm formation
rationale: All members concern Wnt ligand production, Frizzled-receptor signaling (calcium/non-canonical) or Wnt-dependent developmental outputs; unlike its subset confusable it adds receptor-level control (FZD ubiquitination, LRP5 mutants) and paraxial mesoderm/cilium members, and unlike the canonical confusables it lacks destruction-complex and TCF/beta-catenin members.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
name: Core PORCN-dependent Wnt secretion and WNT5A-calcium signaling
rationale: All seven members are either Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion (PORCN, trafficking, secretion regulation) or the WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical branch; it is the minimal core lacking the receptor-regulation and mesoderm members of its superset confusable, the PCP/convergent-extension members of C4, and the canonical TCF/destruction-complex members of C2/C3.
